inputs.text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is calling for outright rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments that are reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. At a press conference, he denounced the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as an unacceptable move by those in power. This is a blatant structural effort by elites to entrench their control and block any path toward equality, which will only deepen the inequalities that have long oppressed working people and vulnerable groups. We must reject this outright and demand institutional reforms that prioritize social justice, labor rights, and protection for the marginalized over preserving power for the few.
